scope: Installed engine/sprites_new: 62 packages, 237 pages; primarily MM6, plus crusader and pmn2
lossless_verification: Every page decoded byte-for-byte equal to input for Zstd levels 3 and 9 and DEFLATE level 6
lossless_decode_caveat: Desktop, 11 pages selected across the size distribution; 5 decodes each; concurrent ASTC probes; not in-game or mobile timing

astc_probe.settings: Existing vendored Arm astc-encoder, medium quality, LDR, alpha-weighted base; unweighted material masks
astc_probe.visual_review: Decoded gobata0 and welatc0 viewed at native output size on dark and light backgrounds. 6x6 visibly coarsens fine details/edges; 4x4 is the safer starting point.
astc_probe.limitations: Historical two-page sample. See full_library_astc_probe for subsequent whole-library size measurements. No final shipping container, full-library visual acceptance, colored-variant shader review, distant-mip gameplay, native GPU upload or Android test. These are native ASTC encodes, not Basis/UASTC measurements.

production_changes: No runtime/asset migration in this review; probes and comparison image are under /tmp/openyamm-atlas-footprint

goblin_full_family_comparison.native_comparison_note: 59 original 8-bit BMPs in current OpenYAMM assets; ZIP entries match by size/CRC. Not an original-game LOD measurement. Shared sprite tables/palette registries and ZIP headers are excluded.

gpu_compressed_probes.note: All 4 pages, base and masks, 5 mip levels. Native ASTC medium-quality probe; lossy. Final shipping-container headers are additional; no runtime migration or Android validation.
All 4 pages, base and masks, 5 mip levels. Native ASTC medium-quality probe; lossy. Final shipping-container headers are additional; no runtime migration or Android validation.

original_sprite_collection.comparison: All current files matched existing engine.zip entries by path and uncompressed size; archive headers excluded.
original_sprite_collection.scope_note: This original sprite collection and the currently restored 62 creature packages have different coverage. Do not extrapolate a whole-game shipping total from one creature.

full_library_astc_probe.settings: Existing vendored Arm astc-encoder, medium quality, LDR, alpha-weighted base; unweighted material masks
full_library_astc_probe.coverage: All current pages; base color and material masks; both profiles encoded and decoded, with decoded byte counts checked against dimensions.
full_library_astc_probe.limitations: Lossy native ASTC probes, not Basis/UASTC or BC7. Full visual/recoloring/mip acceptance, final container integration, native compressed GPU upload and Android validation remain outstanding. Whole-library GPU totals are not gameplay residency measurements.

current_shipping_comparison.units: Bytes; report MB and GB are decimal.

baseline.removal_caveat: Removing originals matched by frame name requires a full runtime-reference audit; the conservative total retains every original BMP.

restored_decorations.note: Existing engine/decorations_x2; no new GPU compression or content stripping applied.

current_shipping_comparison.shipping_layout: Ship one selected compressed runtime profile, manifests and palette LUTs; omit source PNG atlases and raw v1 cooked copies. Retain originals unless a runtime-reference audit proves removal safe.
current_shipping_comparison.scope: Original engine/sprites plus the currently restored 62 creature packages and, where stated, engine/decorations_x2. Not an eventual full MM6/MM7/MM8 restoration or whole-game package estimate.
current_shipping_comparison.container_caveat: Final archive/container headers are additional. Metadata/palettes and decorations use per-file DEFLATE level 6; native sprite entries use existing engine.zip compressed sizes.

full_trilogy_replacement_only_projection.scope: Current merged MM6/MM7/MM8 native creature roster and restored non-creature sprite set, one selected x2 representation only; original backups, authoring PNGs for cooked creatures, unused poses and custom 901+ descriptors excluded. User-excluded snow remains excluded.
full_trilogy_replacement_only_projection.original_method: Unique referenced physical BMPs; existing matching ZIP-entry compressed sizes, otherwise per-file raw DEFLATE-6. Native-resolution OpenYAMM BMP representation, not original LOD sizes.
full_trilogy_replacement_only_projection.projection_method: Calibrate compressed bytes per unique enhanced crop pixel using the full 60 installed MM6-package ASTC4/Zstd probe. Use needed enhanced crop rectangles from available candidate manifests (MM6 60, MM7 67, MM8 30). Estimate missing family crop area using native foreground bounds times the measured enhanced/native area ratio. Allow shared-family deduplication and small metadata/container overhead in the rounded total.
full_trilogy_replacement_only_projection.limitations: Projection, not a complete trilogy runtime cook. Candidate art is not all accepted. Future artwork/masks/packing can change compression; range is a planning allowance, not a confidence interval. Platform-specific format size, visual and runtime validation remain. Historical missing art is not invented. Maps, surface textures, UI packages, audio, video and executable excluded.
